name: appliances
description: Fridges, washing machines, ovens and small home appliances, new or used.

ships.description: True when the seller ships the item. False or absent: handed over in person.

howDealsGo: The buyer checks it works, then pays and releases in one tap; when the seller delivers, the buyer pays into escrow first and releases once it is in and running. A timer to the seller, set past the delivery, pays if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, check it fits the space and the power supply where it is going.
